examples.label: Country picker in a checkout address form
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-native-select" site="Global" id="select-checkout-country" name="country" label="Country or region" description="We show prices and delivery times for this country." size="small" rounded="medium"> <:option value="" disabled="disabled" selected>Select a country <:option value="de">Germany <:option value="fr">France <:option value="nl">Netherlands <:option value="es">Spain <:option value="it">Italy <:option value="gb">United Kingdom

examples.label: Support ticket priority with helper text
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-native-select" site="Global" id="select-ticket-priority" name="priority" label="Priority" description="Urgent tickets page the on-call engineer straight away." size="small" rounded="medium" color="natural"> <:option value="low">Low, answer within three days <:option value="normal" selected>Normal, answer within one day <:option value="high">High, answer within four hours <:option value="urgent">Urgent, site is down

examples.label: Multi-select of newsletter topics
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-native-select" site="Global" id="select-newsletter-topics" name="topics[]" label="Topics you want to hear about" description="Hold Ctrl, or Command on a Mac, to pick more than one." size="small" rounded="medium" multiple min_height="min-h-36"> <:option value="releases" selected>Product releases <:option value="guides">Guides and tutorials <:option value="engineering">Engineering write-ups <:option value="events">Events and meetups <:option value="offers">Offers and discounts
